learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to count numbers beyond 100, make a double century, and skip count!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In cricket, when a player scores 100 runs, it is called a century! If they score 200 runs, it is a double century. We can count all the way to 200!
Instead of counting one by one, we can jump like a frog! We can count in 10s like 10, 20, 30, or in 50s like 50, 100, 150.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Cricket Score Board
fun_activity.instructions: Watch a cricket match or play a game with friends. Try to keep track of the score by jumping in 10s on a piece of paper!

quick_recap: ⭐ A century means exactly 100 of something.
⭐ Skip counting helps us count big numbers very fast!
